Great — answers inline below and a conservative checklist you can hand to your mobile/web teams.

1) Client-side base_url TTL
- Risk: if apps cache base_url for 5 minutes you will see a subset of clients continue hitting staging until their TTL expires. For blue/green we recommend setting TTL <= 60s or performing a short DNS TTL drop + cache-busting header on the SDK side.
- If you cannot change the release, we will route 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20 minutes to mitigate impact; plan smoke tests at each step.

2) SDK cache helper
- Our latest SDK (v1.8.2+) includes a helper: RedwoodClient.invalidateBaseUrlCache() that forces a synchronous refresh. If you are on v1.7.x, you'll need a client patch.
- Attached hb-sdk-samples.tar.gz contains a quick patch and a small wrapper for older SDKs.

3) Migration-safe SDK snippet (apply at T-10m):

// PSEUDO-JS (apply changes atomically)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, baseUrl: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL });

// switch endpoint (atomic)
client.updateConfig({ baseUrl: 'https://api-redwood-prod.hummingbird.ai' });
// force cache refresh for pinned clients
if (client.invalidateBaseUrlCache) client.invalidateBaseUrlCache();

4) Retries / timeouts recommendation
- Client timeout: 6s (connect) / 30s (read) for standard generation endpoints.
- Retries: 3 attempts max with exponential backoff: 500ms -> 1s -> 2s (jitter + capped at 5s).
- For idempotent health checks use a shorter timeout and higher retry.

5) Rate limit handling
- Treat 429s as transient. Inspect Retry-After header and back off accordingly.
- Implement a token bucket limiter on the client side: burst capacity = 2x baseline QPS; sustained refill = agreed QPS.
- On server side, Redwood will temporarily queue up to 10s of requests per node; if queue exceeds threshold we'll return 429 with diagnostic code 429.RATE_HIGH.

6) Rollback triggers (we'll monitor these):
- Error rate > 2.5% for 5 consecutive minutes (5xx and 4xx combined).
- Median P50 latency > 1.5x baseline for 10 minutes.
- Spike of 429s with no Retry-After header.

Attachments included in this reply: hb-sdk-samples.tar.gz (small snippets), env-variables-template.txt (example env var layout). Also uploading the checklist to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/HL/HL-2026-042/traffic-shift

If you'd like, we can push a temporary client-side header X-RW-BYPASS-CACHE during the window to help pinned clients.

-Jordan
